description: Source file implementing PlaybackEventsRecorder class for media event tracking, including bitrate estimation and event recording.

classes.name: PlaybackEventsRecorder

methods.description: Creates and owns an instance of PlaybackEventsRecorder, binding it to a Mojo receiver.

methods.description: Handles seeking event, sets buffering state.

methods.description: Handles buffering start, updates buffering state, pauses bitrate estimator.
